slides.title: AI History
slides.content: **From early ideas to modern intelligent systems**

slides.title: Early Foundations (1940s–1950s)
slides.content: Theoretical and computational foundations set the stage for AI.
bullets: Turing’s work on computation and machine intelligence (1950)
Early programs for logic, games, and problem solving

slides.title: Symbolic AI & Expert Systems (1960s–1980s)
slides.content: Researchers focused on rules, knowledge, and reasoning.
bullets: Growth of symbolic methods and knowledge representation
Periods of optimism followed by AI winters due to limits and funding cuts

slides.title: Machine Learning Rises (1990s–2010s)
slides.content: Data and statistical methods became central to progress.
bullets: Advances in probabilistic models and neural networks
Deep learning breakthroughs in vision and speech (2012+)

slides.title: Modern Era (2017–Today)
slides.content: Large-scale models expanded capabilities and adoption.
bullets: Generative AI for text, code, and media
Wider deployment across products, science, and business
Growing focus on safety, alignment, and governance

slides.title: Looking Ahead
slides.content: AI continues to evolve through research, applications, and responsible development.
bullets: Emphasis on trust, ethics, and societal impact
